card.name: Comma in "If no author is given,"
card.fires_on: The comma after "If no author is given" in the citation note on science news pages ("the source is cited instead"). It also fires weakly on the comma in a list of contact details.

modes.label: Citation note comma
modes.description: Comma ending the clause "If no author is given" in the note about citing the source.
modes.example: Note: If no author is given<<,>> the source is cited instead.

modes.label: Contact list comma
modes.description: Comma inside a list of details readers should include when writing to the editor.
modes.example: Please include your full name<<,>> address and phone number (the city

card.plain: It marks the comma in a stock note on science news pages saying the source is cited when no author is named.
